title: Corruption
description: My own custom-made texturepack called Corruption
body:
A custom-made resourcepack made by the Minecraft Youtuber Ri43Q. This is the resourcepack he uses in his videos. This texturepack focuses mainly on PvP related textures. Some other textures were changed, like the texture of grass blocks, deepslate, and stone, which were made to be smoother.

Check him out: https://www.youtube.com/@Ri43Q
